title: Prove the complete cost bound for identity-native Gaussian coframes
body:
This settles the local cost comparison left open by [Dugongue's PR5665 coframe construction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5665). For every admitted Clifford coframe choice and every **0<t<=1**,

`paid_moment - changed_helper_moment >= 232*8^t > 0`.

Each persistent helper transport path pays at least its actual two-sided target grade. The 224 main paths and eight centre operations then supply the strict residual. The local paid moment is at least **1+232/459** times the helper moment when that moment is nonzero. This accepts the proposed operator identity but rules out a favorable standalone helper-versus-paid comparison. **No new kappa is claimed.**

The proof covers arbitrary Clifford coframes, paid transport splitting, joining and tensor width. It also shows P>=T for any complete supplier that satisfies the same identity-native path contract. It does **not** classify arbitrary outer callers: a supplied larger caller must still fund the explicit local residual and every external cost. Nonidentity logical natives, changed ownership, or proved zero-only original header jumps are outside the result.

Both complete source directions pass the retained free-group replay and a separate identity-native scalar replay on all 632 original columns. All 448 main normalizers and eight centre operations per direction are bound to the literal word. There is no whole-zero original or centre query available for omission in either specialization. The exact target census debits both ends, including the six changed (1,8) helper pairs.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4687cb9b5b6aabe7d83a418bbdbdeb4b948c6344/research/identity-native-coframe-cost/PROOF.md), [exact evidence](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4687cb9b5b6aabe7d83a418bbdbdeb4b948c6344/research/identity-native-coframe-cost/RESULT.json), [scope and replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4687cb9b5b6aabe7d83a418bbdbdeb4b948c6344/research/identity-native-coframe-cost/README.md), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4687cb9b5b6aabe7d83a418bbdbdeb4b948c6344/research/identity-native-coframe-cost/SOURCES.json).

Independent finite evidence covers all 2,463,777 Lagrangian triangles in one through three axes and all 518,400 products of the 720 elements of Sp(4,2). Wrong forward-image coframes fail on 239,616 pairs. Eighteen actual coordinate fixtures and source/boundary controls corroborate the written theorem; their minimum is not an optimization claim.

Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized checks, actual source-corruption rejection, all 17 committed-file checks, official export integrity and a fresh Git-free optimized replay pass. Full-history ancestry preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Hosted CI and independent human/formal acceptance are separate. Selected .00310045 is unchanged; no new physical supplier or full outer replay is asserted.

Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Dugongue for the specialization and phase-exact compiler, Cao Yifan PR4610, Cinna Davis and the retained native/controller/helper lineage. Original notices remain in the package; [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4687cb9b5b6aabe7d83a418bbdbdeb4b948c6344/research/identity-native-coframe-cost/NOTICE.md) distinguishes source construction from this cost proof and its verification.
